beats.text: Rama and Lakshmana searched everywhere for Sita, calling her name through forests and mountains. Rama asked the trees, the rivers and the deer if they had seen her.
Suddenly, a giant demon named Kabandha seized them in his arms. He had no head or neck. His mouth was in his belly, and a single fiery eye glowed in his chest.
Rama and Lakshmana freed themselves from his giant arms. Kabandha crashed to the ground and cried out in relief.
'I was a celestial named Danu,' he said. 'Indra struck me with his thunderbolt and drove my head into my body. Only you could free me.'
The brothers burned his body on a great fire. From the flames rose a radiant being, shining in a celestial chariot.
He gave them a clue: 'Seek Sugriva, king of the monkeys, at Mount Rishyamukha. He knows Ravana's way. And first, visit Shabari.'
